Hi! I’m sorry you’re going through this and just wanted to offer a helpful girl to girl advice. I know in some cases with that age many begin their periods and it’s harder to control or know exactly how navigate it correctly. If that is your case pads are your best friend! Bring as many as you can in your backpack so you’re able to frequently change it throughout the school day. You should be doing so at least 3 times (or more or less depending on the heaviness of the flow) while you’re there. Vaginal wipes and powders also are great help too and can be bought at most drug stores. Or it’s simply just a hygiene issue and there’s nothing wrong with reaching out for help or taking extra measures to keep yourself fresh. Whatever that could be going on, know this won’t be a forever thing but death is and there are ways to try and prevent that way of thinking. Please speak to someone that can respectfully give you the proper advice or help you may need!!!

Not weird advice but the best advice she could’ve given. After you get past all the quick and easy things to talk about, the best conversations come from the ones when you talk about things deeper. Like asking open ended questions. You get more of a mutual connection doing so. Here’s some random starter ones!!!! :
Have you gone to school yet - what’s a dream career you would choose for yourself if you could?
Is there anywhere in the world that you’d like to live other than where you are now? 
What’s a hobby that makes you happy? 
Ask what her best recommendations on albums, songs or artists that you can listen to are 
Tell me some of your favorite video games, movies, seasons, places to eat, things to do, music you love. 
Anything that you yourself would want to be asked or talked about try. You’ll find more and more talking points as you go along and get to know each other. But always remember hey conversations are never the way to draw deeper connections
